finance/convert-xbrl.error: CS1061: 'int' does not contain a definition for 'Facts'
finance/convert-xbrl.root_cause: XbrlInstances.Add() returns int index, not XbrlInstance object
finance/convert-xbrl.fix: Use XbrlDocument.Instances[index] after Add(), or simplify to load/save pattern

note/convert-onenote-to-pdf.root_cause: Aspose.Note Page(), Outline(), OutlineElement(), RichText() are parameterless constructors
note/convert-onenote-to-pdf.fix: Use parameterless constructors, set properties after construction

note/convert-onenote-to-image.fix: Same fix as convert-onenote-to-pdf, save as PNG with ImageSaveOptions

ocr/scan-document.error: CS1069: System.Drawing.Bitmap not available without System.Drawing.Common
ocr/scan-document.root_cause: System.Drawing types forwarded to System.Drawing.Common on .NET 6+
ocr/scan-document.fix: Avoid System.Drawing entirely; use File.WriteAllText to create test input, or add System.Drawing.Common package

ocr/image-text-finder.fix: Same — avoid System.Drawing, use simple file-based approach

psd/animation-maker.root_cause: PsdImage is in Aspose.PSD.FileFormats.Psd namespace, not root Aspose.PSD

tex/latex-figure-renderer.error: CS1729: TeXOptions does not have 1-arg constructor
tex/latex-figure-renderer.root_cause: TeXOptions uses static factory method ConsoleAppOptions() or similar
tex/latex-figure-renderer.fix: Use TeXOptions.ConsoleAppOptions() factory, or use MathRenderer/FigureRenderer API
